about_the_game:
Alchemy Duel

Alchemy × Card Battle × Roguelike.
A single-player pixel-art card game where you aim to conquer all eight stages through ever-changing combinations and strategies.

Key Features

Synthesize through alchemy
Combine Material Cards to craft new Buddy Cards.
Each Buddy has unique effects, and summoning the right one at the right time is the key to victory.

Tactical turn-based battles
The placement of Buddy Cards affects their synergy with other Buddies, Relics, and enemy attacks.
Like auto-chess, positioning is part of the strategy.

Enhance your deck with Relics
Purchase Relics in shops after battles to empower your Buddies.
Relic combinations allow for limitless strategic possibilities.

Roguelike challenges
Enemies and rewards change with every run.
How you manage your resources determines your success.
Even in defeat, new combinations await, offering high replayability.

A world of alchemical battles in pixel art
Retro-style visuals and animated monsters bring each battle to life.

short_description: Alchemy Duel is a card game that combines elements of alchemy and roguelike gameplay. Alchemize monsters suited to the situation and unleash powerful combos by making use of synergies between your cards!
